description: Chinese product memory for a reporting app: release plans, pricing, templates and roadmap focus. Evidence is two roadmap meetings (2026-09-03 and a 2026-09-24 re-review that postponed bulk export), a 2026-03-02 decision log, the pricing ADR, a weekly product report and release notes. Hard parts: proposals versus decisions, a web-only rollout figure, the pricing grace period for existing customers, Chinese numerals (一成, 三秒), a dated decision that is now over 180 days old, and negation-character traps (未来, 非常, 无论, 非得, 不仅…而且).
